verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Hatchet serves an llms.txt at https://docs.hatchet.run/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a Hatchet Documentation header and summary, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Beyond that, the evidence only shows a truncated opening, so its depth and coverage are unverified. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown docs, verification of the llms.txt content's depth and coverage, and independent or community corroboration of agents using it.
